artifacts.summary: Implementation plan for ExistPart_r generalization to close k>0 depth induction sorries blocking completeness_discrete

memory_candidates.content: When a formal proof's ExistPart/composition theorem uses constant-parent environments (fun _ => t) but the proof obligation involves non-constant environments [x, t], the solution is to parameterize ExistPart by parent NF types (ExistPart_r with r parent NFs). This is the Lean analog of GHR94 Section 12.8's decomposition formulas. The key insight: 1-var NF agreement at points x and t separately does NOT determine the 2-var NF at [x, t] -- a genuine information gap that no amount of transfer lemma chaining can bridge within the constant-parent constraint. The fix is architectural (change the definition), not tactical (work within the existing definition).
